consent.title: Location tracking consent
consent.description: Location tracking sends this driver's GPS position to dispatch and to customers viewing the public tracking link while a load is in transit. Tracking cannot start until the driver grants consent, and it stops immediately if consent is withdrawn.
consent.notGranted: Tracking consent has not been granted.
consent.revokeSuccess: Tracking consent revoked. Any open tracking sessions for this driver have been ended.
consent.ownActionOnly: A driver may only grant or revoke their own tracking consent.

session.notStarted: Tracking has not started for this load.
session.noPositionYet: No position has been reported yet.
session.simulateHint: Development tool — only available while the mock tracking provider is active. Advances the simulated driver along the calculated route and ingests whatever events newly become visible.
session.simulateSuccess: Advanced the simulated session by {minutes} minutes ({count} new event(s)).

health.unknownDescription: No event has been received yet.

health.lostDescription: No event in over {minutes} minutes — signal may be lost.
